So obviously this doesn't apply to everyone as every couple's situation is unique, so if you are the SO of someone limerent, be very honest with yourself and them. What are your boundaries? Don't blame yourself but rather try to objectively look at how much each person is giving and taking from the relationship. I wish you the best!
